notes: CLD1 is a compact induction (hearing) loop amplifier/driver for counter and small perimeter loop systems, not a video/AV switching device. All specs confirmed via the manufacturer's own product page (listentech.com/product/cld1/) and cross-checked against the official Listen Technologies datasheet for SKU CLD001CX ("CLD1 Induction Loop Driver, Loop Coil, No Mic"), created 2024-09-27, distributed via ADI Global's CDN (cdn.adiglobaldistribution.us/pim/Original/10313/LM-CLD001CX_Product-Data-Sheet.pdf). That datasheet's front-panel product photo shows the labels used above: MLC (a gain/metal-loss-correction control knob, not a connector), INPUT 1, INPUT 2 (with an "Input 2 Select: Line-Mic" switch), DC IN 12V/1.0A, and LOOP OUTPUT — all on a single face of the unit. The panel also bears "Ampetronic" branding above the CLD1 model designation (Ampetronic is a UK hearing-loop specialist; this unit appears to be an Ampetronic-engineered design sold under the Listen Technologies CLD1 name/SKU — could not fully confirm the OEM relationship). No connector on this device is a bandwidth-graded type (no HDMI/SDI/DP/USB/Ethernet), so no "grade" values apply. Desktop/freestanding unit (5.0 x 2.9 x 1.4 in, wall-mountable) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Power: 12VDC, 1.0A, 18W via included external power supply (North America version); other regional power-supply variants may differ but the DC-in jack on the unit itself is unchanged.

ports.name: INPUT 1
ports.note: Unbalanced 3.5mm mono (TS) microphone input for electret mic, 6VDC bias. List has no dedicated mono-TS-3.5mm id, so the closest listed connector (trs-3.5) was used; the physical jack is mono, not stereo/TRS.

ports.name: INPUT 2
ports.note: Switchable Mic/Line input, unbalanced 3.5mm mono (TS) connector, selected via the rear 'Input 2 Select: Line-Mic' switch. Same connector-type caveat as Input 1 applies.

ports.name: LOOP OUTPUT
ports.note: Datasheet lists this as a 'Level Cable Clamp' — a fixed screw-type bare-wire terminal for the induction loop cable, not a pluggable Euroblock/terminal-block connector. Euroblock was chosen as the closest listed id.
